messages.snippet: Dear Alice, Thank you for asking us to act on the proposed licence of the LBX-Series technology to V
messages.subject: Project Cedar — engagement and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Alice,

Thank you for asking us to act on the proposed licence of the LBX-Series technology to Verrell Beauty Group. I attach our engagement letter for signature, which sets out scope, our team (myself, James Osei and Elena Marchetti) and our fee estimate.

As a first step we will get the NDA in place with Verrell so that we can share the patent schedule and the know-how summary. I will send a draft NDA across to their side today.

Do let me know if you have any questions on the engagement terms.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Thanks — engagement letter received and being signed today; I'll have it back to you tomorrow. I've copied Priya Joshi (our Head of Legal) who will be your day-to-day contact on our side.

We're keen to move reasonably quickly here; Verrell want to be in a position to brief their formulation team in the new year. NDA first makes sense.

Alice
